Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check — onsite demo timing and logistics

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for agreeing to host the onsite demo next week. Quick logistics note: we have you down for Wednesday, Apr 29 at 11:00 AM PT (2:00 PM ET). Connor (solutions) and Stephanie (CS) will join us on-site.

Attached is the demo agenda (short, 30–45 min product walkthrough + 15 min Q&A) and a one-line consent text we ask for when recording the session. If anything in the agenda looks off, say so and I can tweak.

Questions before we lock the calendar: any building check-in requirements or an alternate contact for site escorts? Also, if your execs will be traveling, do you want to push to the following week? We can do a brief working session or record the core demo if travel can't be changed.

—Sooj

Soojin Lee

soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@sunwell.com>

Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check — onsite demo timing and logistics

Hi Soojin —

Sorry for the short notice — our VP of Ops just informed me she'll be on a client site visit the afternoon of Apr 29 and wants to join the demo. That means the 11:00 AM PT slot looks risky for her travel window.

Two options that would work on our side: 1) move to Wed, May 6 at 09:00 AM PT, or 2) keep Apr 29 but do a shorter 25-minute live session in the morning and send the recording to the execs who can't make it. If we go with option 1 we can guarantee broader attendance.

We also have a field visit the week of May 4–8; if you propose May 6 please confirm on-site versus virtual — some of our folks will be at the field office that day and prefer remote.

Thanks for being flexible — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director, Process Improvements | SunWell Logistics
agomez@sunwell.com | +1 (617) 555-4420

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick check — onsite demo timing and logistics

Hi Alicia —

Totally understand — travel windows are the worst. Two quick thoughts:

- If you prefer May 6 we can run a 45-min remote session at 09:00 AM PT and include the 15-min technical deep-dive as an optional break-out for engineers (we'll stay online). That should cover both exec-level overview and the engineers.
- If you want to keep Apr 29, we can move the live portion to 10:00 AM PT and I can do a short on-site setup with Stephanie to record the core 20–25 minutes so the execs can watch later. We'd still do a 10–15 min live Q&A for folks on site.

I've attached an updated agenda with both time bands called out (see "Redwood_Onsite_Agenda_v2.pdf") and marked which sections are recommended for recording. Also included a one-line consent file for your records.

If May 6 is better, I'll update the calendar and send Zoom details / dial-in. If Apr 29 is preferred, please confirm 10:00 AM PT and we'll keep it lean.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Appreciate the heads-up and flexibility — see you May 6.
